zh-CN.title: 奖励揭晓舞台重新聚焦
items: 当前奖励改为单张主舞台，已领取奖励收纳进横向成长轨道
修复奖励名称断行、默认气泡和无边框头像的失真预览
个性化奖励以统一尺寸复用真实外观，不再使用空白占位

en.title: A sharper reward reveal stage
items: The current reward now owns the stage while received rewards move into a compact history rail
Fixed broken reward titles and inaccurate default bubble and frameless avatar previews
Personalization rewards now share consistent proportions and reuse their real appearance
